source_title: Saudi Arabia Internship Programme | Pinsent Masons
source_summary: A three-month Riyadh internship for Saudi students and recent graduates, working alongside lawyers and business professionals. The official Saudi programme index marks internship applications open and the separate COOP programme closed.
offer_summary: Starts 11 October 2026; three months; rolling applications opened in September. Monthly allowance, amount not stated. Mentorship and practical legal exposure.
responsibilities: Work alongside Riyadh lawyers and business professionals.
Develop professional skills and commercial awareness; practice-group exposure depends on business requirements.
qualifications: Saudi national or long-term resident in Saudi Arabia.
Penultimate year or beyond of a law degree at a recognised Saudi university.
Minimum GPA of 2.5/4.0 or equivalent, achieved or on track.
Submit an up-to-date CV, cover letter and current academic transcript(s).
eligibility_summary: Saudi national or long-term resident; penultimate-year law student or beyond at a recognised Saudi university; minimum GPA 2.5/4.0 or equivalent.
eligibility_source_text: The programme states Saudi nationality or long-term residence, penultimate-year-or-beyond law study at a recognised Saudi university, and a 2.5/4.0 minimum GPA or equivalent.
editorial_assessment: A time-limited placement, not a permanent job. Future full-time or trainee-lawyer consideration is possible, not guaranteed. The internship and the closed COOP route must not be conflated.
provenance_notes: Employer Saudi index and internship detail returned HTTP 200 on 30 September 2026. Both Apply Now anchors on the detail page pointed to Oracle job 3672 in CX_1004. Rolling closure, start date and eligibility were read from that page. No exact posting day or allowance amount is supplied; the LinkedIn relative timestamp is not treated as an opening date.
